name: Credit Crunch
description: Widening credit spreads and tightening lending standards threaten to choke economic growth

phases.name: Spreads Widen
headlines: Corporate bond spreads blow out to widest levels in three years
High-yield debt market effectively frozen as investors flee risk
Banks report sharp increase in loan loss provisions
phases.summary: A sudden widening of credit spreads signals growing stress in corporate debt markets and tightening financial conditions.

phases.name: Lending Freeze
headlines: Commercial lending effectively halted as banks hoard capital
Small businesses report inability to access credit at any price
Leveraged loan market collapse threatens private equity portfolios
phases.summary: Banks halt new lending and hoard capital as the credit squeeze intensifies, threatening economic activity.

phases.name: Central Bank Thaw
headlines: Central bank launches emergency credit facility to unfreeze markets
Corporate bond buying program announced to restore market function
Credit markets respond positively to aggressive policy intervention
phases.summary: Aggressive central bank intervention with emergency facilities and bond purchases thaws frozen credit markets.

phases.name: Systemic Seizure
headlines: Major corporate defaults cascade through credit markets
Credit default swap market faces settlement crisis
Financial system on brink as counterparty risk becomes unquantifiable
phases.summary: Cascading corporate defaults overwhelm the credit system, creating a systemic crisis of counterparty risk.

phases.name: Credit Normalization
headlines: Credit spreads return to normal ranges as confidence rebuilds
Lending activity resumes as banks ease underwriting standards
phases.summary: Credit markets normalize with spreads returning to pre-crisis levels and lending activity resuming.

phases.name: Economic Contraction
headlines: GDP contracts sharply as credit crisis chokes real economy
Unemployment surges as businesses unable to refinance debt collapse
Government forced into massive fiscal intervention to prevent depression
phases.summary: The credit crisis spills into the real economy causing severe GDP contraction and surging unemployment.

name: Bond Market Selloff
description: A sharp rise in bond yields creates a duration crisis and spills over into equity markets

phases.name: Yield Spike
headlines: 10-year treasury yield surges 50 basis points in a single week
Bond market selloff intensifies as inflation expectations surge
Duration-sensitive assets hammered by sharpest yield move in years
phases.summary: A sudden spike in bond yields driven by shifting inflation expectations creates turmoil across fixed income markets.

phases.name: Duration Crisis
headlines: Long-duration portfolios face catastrophic mark-to-market losses
Growth stocks plunge as rising rates compress valuations
Mortgage rates spike, threatening housing market and refinancing activity
phases.summary: Rising yields expose massive duration risk in institutional portfolios and compress growth stock valuations.

phases.name: Yields Stabilize
headlines: Bond market finds equilibrium as buyers emerge at higher yield levels
Central bank signals flexibility on rate path, calming bond market
Duration-sensitive assets recover as yield volatility subsides
phases.summary: Bond yields find a new equilibrium level as buyers return and central bank communication calms markets.

phases.name: Cascade Effect
headlines: Bond selloff triggers forced liquidation across pension and insurance portfolios
Margin calls on leveraged bond positions create self-reinforcing selling spiral
Emerging market currencies collapse as global yields surge
phases.summary: The bond selloff cascades into forced liquidation across leveraged portfolios and emerging market contagion.

phases.name: New Rate Regime
headlines: Markets adapt to higher rate environment as economy proves resilient
Value rotation complete as investors adjust to normalized yields
phases.summary: Equity markets adapt to the new higher-rate environment with a completed rotation from growth to value.

phases.name: Financial Instability
headlines: Central bank forced into emergency bond purchases to restore stability
Multiple institutional failures as bond losses exceed capital buffers
Markets question central bank credibility as interventions seen as capitulation
phases.summary: Emergency central bank bond purchases stabilize markets but raise serious questions about policy credibility and moral hazard.

name: Regional Bank Crisis
description: Deposit flight from regional banks sparks contagion fears across the banking sector

phases.name: Deposit Flight
headlines: Regional bank stocks plunge as depositors flee to larger institutions
Social media fuels bank run fears as withdrawal lines form
FDIC scrambles to reassure depositors as regional bank shares crater
phases.summary: A sudden loss of confidence triggers deposit flight from regional banks into larger institutions perceived as safer.

phases.name: Contagion Spreads
headlines: Second regional bank placed into receivership over weekend
Banking index suffers worst decline since 2008 on contagion fears
Short sellers target weakest regional banks as crisis widens
phases.summary: The failure of a second institution spreads contagion across the regional banking sector with aggressive short selling.

phases.name: Crisis Contained
headlines: Government announces blanket deposit guarantee for all banks
Emergency lending facility calms regional bank liquidity concerns
Regional bank stocks rebound sharply as government backstop takes effect
phases.summary: Decisive government action with deposit guarantees and emergency lending facilities contains the banking crisis.

phases.name: Spreading Panic
headlines: Third and fourth regional banks fail as deposit insurance fund strained
Large banks refuse to acquire failed institutions without massive guarantees
International banks cut exposure to US financial system amid turmoil
phases.summary: Multiple additional bank failures overwhelm the deposit insurance system and trigger international contagion.

phases.name: Sector Heals
headlines: Regional bank deposits stabilize as confidence gradually returns
Surviving regional banks report improved metrics, shares rally
phases.summary: Deposit flows stabilize and surviving regional banks report improving fundamentals as the crisis fades.

phases.name: Banking Consolidation
headlines: Emergency legislation forces massive banking sector consolidation
Too-big-to-fail banks grow even larger absorbing regional failures
Credit availability permanently reduced as community banking model collapses
phases.summary: The crisis permanently reshapes the banking landscape with forced consolidation and reduced credit availability.

name: Sovereign Debt Scare
description: A sovereign credit downgrade triggers a spike in government borrowing costs and market turmoil

phases.name: Rating Downgrade
headlines: Major economy loses top credit rating as deficit concerns mount
Sovereign CDS spreads spike to highest level in a decade
Government bond auction draws weak demand following downgrade
phases.summary: A surprise sovereign credit downgrade sends government borrowing costs surging and rattles global markets.

phases.name: CDS Spike
headlines: Sovereign default insurance costs triple as debt trajectory questioned
Foreign investors dump government bonds at accelerating pace
Currency plunges as capital flight accelerates on fiscal concerns
phases.summary: Exploding CDS spreads and foreign capital flight create a vicious cycle of rising borrowing costs and currency weakness.

phases.name: Fiscal Response
headlines: Government announces credible austerity package to restore fiscal discipline
International institutions pledge support as reform program announced
Bond yields retreat as market gains confidence in fiscal adjustment
phases.summary: A credible fiscal adjustment plan backed by international support restores market confidence in sovereign debt.

phases.name: Default Risk Rising
headlines: Government fails to pass austerity measures as political crisis deepens
Debt restructuring speculation intensifies as borrowing costs become unsustainable
Contagion fears spread to other vulnerable sovereign borrowers
phases.summary: Political inability to address fiscal problems pushes sovereign default risk higher and spreads contagion.

phases.name: Confidence Restored
headlines: Sovereign spreads normalize as reform implementation on track
Rating agencies signal potential upgrade on improved fiscal outlook
phases.summary: Successful implementation of fiscal reforms normalizes borrowing costs and opens the door to a rating upgrade.

phases.name: Restructuring
headlines: Government announces debt restructuring negotiations with creditors
Bondholders face significant haircuts as restructuring terms emerge
Global markets reel as sovereign default becomes reality
phases.summary: Sovereign debt restructuring imposes significant losses on bondholders and sends shockwaves through global markets.

name: Pension Fund Crisis
description: A liability mismatch forces pension funds into disorderly asset sales, destabilizing markets

phases.name: Liability Mismatch Exposed
headlines: Major pension funds report worst funding ratios in decades
Falling asset values and rising liabilities create pension funding crisis
Regulators demand emergency action as pension shortfalls mushroom
phases.summary: A collision of falling asset values and rising liabilities exposes critical funding gaps across major pension funds.

phases.name: Forced Selling
headlines: Pension funds begin fire sale of assets to meet collateral requirements
Gilt market thrown into chaos by pension fund forced selling
Equity markets plunge as institutional liquidation accelerates
phases.summary: Pension funds are forced into disorderly asset liquidation to meet margin calls, creating a cascading market selloff.

phases.name: Central Bank Backstop
headlines: Central bank launches targeted intervention to halt pension fund death spiral
Emergency bond buying program restores order to government debt market
Pension funds given regulatory breathing room to unwind positions orderly
phases.summary: Targeted central bank intervention breaks the forced selling spiral and gives pension funds time to restructure.

phases.name: Systemic Contagion
headlines: Pension crisis spreads to insurance sector as shared asset classes plunge
Multiple pension schemes declared insolvent requiring government intervention
Broader financial stability threatened as institutional selling overwhelms markets
phases.summary: The pension crisis spreads to insurance companies and overwhelms markets as multiple schemes become insolvent.

phases.name: Orderly Resolution
headlines: Pension funds complete orderly deleveraging with market stability maintained
New regulations mandate simpler pension investment strategies
phases.summary: Pension funds successfully deleverage and new regulations prevent future liability mismatches.

phases.name: Taxpayer Bailout
headlines: Government announces massive pension bailout funded by taxpayers
Political backlash erupts over pension industry moral hazard
Markets stabilize but confidence in institutional framework shattered
phases.summary: A costly taxpayer-funded bailout stabilizes the pension system but creates lasting political and moral hazard concerns.

name: Commercial Real Estate Crisis
description: Post-pandemic office vacancy crisis causes REIT collapses and exposes bank CRE loan portfolios

phases.name: Vacancy Surge
headlines: Office vacancy rates hit all-time record as remote work becomes permanent
Major REIT stocks plunge as commercial property valuations slashed 40%
Trophy office buildings sell at fraction of pre-pandemic prices
phases.summary: Office vacancy hits record levels as the remote work shift becomes permanent, causing REIT stocks to plunge and property valuations to crater.

phases.name: Bank Exposure
headlines: Regional banks reveal billions in commercial real estate loan losses
CRE loan delinquencies surge to highest level since financial crisis
Contagion fears spread as banks scramble to assess office loan exposure
phases.summary: Regional banks disclose massive losses on commercial real estate loans, sparking contagion fears across the banking sector.

phases.name: Adaptive Reuse
headlines: Massive office-to-residential conversion wave stabilizes urban real estate
Government tax incentives accelerate adaptive reuse of vacant office towers
Mixed-use redevelopment projects attract institutional investment capital
phases.summary: A wave of office-to-residential conversions supported by government incentives stabilizes the commercial real estate market.

phases.name: Loan Default Wave
headlines: CMBS default rate spikes as commercial mortgage maturities hit wall
Special servicers overwhelmed by volume of distressed CRE loans
Bank stress tests reveal systemic underestimation of CRE risk
phases.summary: A cascade of CMBS defaults overwhelms special servicers and reveals systemic CRE risk underestimation across the banking sector.

phases.name: Market Stabilizes
headlines: Commercial real estate finds new equilibrium at lower but stable valuations
Surviving REITs report improved occupancy as market rebalances
phases.summary: The commercial real estate market reaches a new equilibrium with lower valuations but stable fundamentals and improving occupancy.

phases.name: Banking Sector Stress
headlines: FDIC issues formal warnings to dozens of banks over CRE concentration
Credit tightening spreads beyond real estate as banks shore up reserves
Small business lending dries up as regional banks retrench from CRE losses
phases.summary: FDIC warnings and bank retrenchment from CRE losses trigger broad credit tightening that chokes small business lending.

name: Crypto Contagion
description: A major stablecoin depeg and exchange collapse triggers retail panic and reveals hidden institutional exposure

phases.name: Stablecoin Depeg
headlines: Major stablecoin loses dollar peg as redemption requests overwhelm reserves
Crypto markets crash 40% in 48 hours as stablecoin confidence evaporates
Panic selling spreads across digital asset ecosystem as liquidity vanishes
phases.summary: A major stablecoin loses its dollar peg triggering a 40% crash across crypto markets and destroying confidence in digital asset stability.

phases.name: Exchange Collapse
headlines: Major crypto exchange halts all withdrawals citing liquidity crisis
Exchange files for bankruptcy revealing billions in missing customer funds
Retail investors face total wipeout as exchange insolvency confirmed
phases.summary: A major crypto exchange halts withdrawals and files for bankruptcy, revealing massive misuse of customer funds.

phases.name: Contained to Crypto
headlines: Traditional financial system firewalls hold as crypto contagion fizzles
Bank regulators confirm minimal exposure to collapsed crypto entities
Equity markets shrug off crypto crisis as limited institutional overlap confirmed
phases.summary: Regulatory firewalls successfully contain the crypto crisis, with traditional financial markets largely unaffected.

phases.name: Contagion Spreads
headlines: Major hedge funds reveal devastating losses from hidden crypto exposure
Fintech stocks crash as payment processors disclose stablecoin reserve holdings
Venture capital markdowns cascade as crypto-adjacent portfolio companies collapse
phases.summary: Hidden institutional crypto exposure surfaces across hedge funds and fintech companies, spreading the crisis to traditional markets.

phases.name: Regulatory Clarity
headlines: Comprehensive crypto regulation framework passed with bipartisan support
Digital asset markets recover under new regulatory certainty
phases.summary: New comprehensive crypto regulations restore confidence and provide a clear framework for digital asset markets to recover.

phases.name: Fintech Winter
headlines: Fintech funding collapses as investors flee anything crypto-adjacent
Wave of fintech layoffs as venture capital dries up overnight
Digital payment innovation stalls as regulatory crackdown freezes sector
phases.summary: A fintech funding freeze triggers mass layoffs and stalls digital payment innovation as the sector enters a deep winter.

name: Insurance Catastrophe
description: A mega natural disaster with record insured losses overwhelms the reinsurance industry and destabilizes financial markets

phases.name: Catastrophe Strikes
headlines: Record-breaking natural disaster causes estimated $200 billion in insured losses
Insurance stocks plunge as catastrophe models prove wildly inadequate
Reinsurance market faces largest single-event payout in history
phases.summary: A mega natural disaster causes record insured losses, shattering catastrophe models and sending insurance stocks into freefall.

phases.name: Reinsurance Crisis
headlines: Major reinsurer downgraded as claims exceed loss reserves by billions
Insurance-linked securities face unprecedented write-downs
Catastrophe bond market freezes as investors reassess climate risk models
phases.summary: Claims exceeding reserves trigger reinsurer downgrades and freeze the catastrophe bond market as climate risk models are discredited.

phases.name: Government Backstop
headlines: Federal disaster insurance fund activated with $100 billion emergency allocation
Government-backed reinsurance facility restores market confidence
Insurance stocks recover as public-private risk sharing framework announced
phases.summary: A massive federal disaster insurance fund and public-private risk sharing framework restores confidence in the insurance sector.

phases.name: Market Withdrawal
headlines: Insurers announce mass withdrawal from disaster-prone states
Millions of homeowners left without coverage as carriers exit markets
State insurance pools overwhelmed as private sector retreats
phases.summary: Insurers pull out of disaster-prone regions en masse, leaving millions without coverage and overwhelming state insurance pools.

phases.name: Premium Adjustment
headlines: Insurance premiums surge 30-50% but industry returns to profitability
Reinsurance capacity rebuilt as higher pricing attracts new capital
phases.summary: Sharply higher premiums restore insurance industry profitability and attract new reinsurance capital to rebuild capacity.

phases.name: Uninsurable Risk
headlines: Climate risk renders vast coastal and wildfire zones permanently uninsurable
Real estate values collapse in uninsurable regions as mortgages become impossible
Economic migration accelerates from areas abandoned by insurance industry
phases.summary: Permanent insurance coverage gaps in climate-vulnerable regions destroy real estate values and trigger economic migration.
